objective: Advance serialized slice commits only on their owning manifest-group worktree and plan-run branch
prefetch: Inspect plan-run branch and integration-head receipt state
Build two serialized slice commits in one disposable plan-run worktree
Capture dirty-state, wrong-branch, stale-head, and post-commit proof behavior before editing
constraints: One manifest group owns one worktree; per-slice worktrees and branches are prohibited
The coordinator alone accepts slice receipts and advances integration_head
Expected serialized head movement is allowed while outside movement fails compare-and-swap validation
Worker proof never replaces aggregate proof in the plan-run worktree
acceptance_criteria: Two serialized slice commits advance one plan-run branch in order
Advance cannot accept another branch or worktree
Unexpected outside head movement fails closed
Dirty-state and aggregate-proof failures remain recoverable
model_tier_reason: Serialized Git integration and conflict recovery can corrupt history or lose work when subtly wrong
escalation_triggers: A slice runs in another branch or worktree
Authorized prior slice advancement is treated as stale base
